patterns.plugin_registration: Fastify plugins are registered in fastify.adapter.ts using await app.register()
patterns.cors_plugin: CORS is registered with await app.register(cors, { ... }) - follow same pattern for helmet
patterns.testing_pattern: Security tests are in apps/api/tests/security/ and use vitest with serverAvailable check
patterns.error_handling: Global error handler uses RFC 7807 Problem Details format
patterns.dependency_management: Dependencies added to apps/api/package.json, installed with pnpm install

existing_implementations.description: Fastify adapter already registers @fastify/cors and @fastify/websocket plugins. The pattern is to register plugins after creating the Fastify instance but before registering controllers.

security_tests.pattern: Tests check server availability before running, use fetch() to make requests, validate response headers

helmet_configuration.notes: For API server serving JSON, CSP can be lenient. HSTS important for production. X-Frame-Options prevents clickjacking.
